task_description: Create a comprehensive agentic workflow system for the repository. 16 GitHub Actions workflows across 4 layers (Core PR/Issue automation, Security/Compliance, Quality/Performance, Release/Deployment) plus supporting configuration files and scripts.

verification.summary: All 16 workflow YAML files validated with pyyaml. Shell scripts pass bash -n syntax check. JSON config validated. All workflows have workflow_dispatch, concurrency groups, and permissions blocks. Integration with existing scripts (uptime-check.sh, accuracy-report.js, four_cloud_delegation_drift.sh) confirmed. Semantic review v1 found 9 issues which were all fixed in commit 188611b.
